## What he does

- He designs and delivers automation systems that remove manual work: lead follow-up, partner and client onboarding, CRM updates, and reporting.
- He works with the tools clients already use: Make, n8n, and Zapier, plus Google Workspace.
- A human approves before anything is sent. Nothing is ever auto-sent.
- He builds by directing AI tools: he specifies, verifies, and delivers working systems. He does not claim hand-coded mastery of programming languages or frameworks.

## Proof: systems he built

- Meeting-to-Deal: an agency post-call system in Make. A call becomes a summary, a CRM sheet row, and a follow-up draft prepared for human approval. Nothing is auto-sent.
- Auto Website Generator + Outreach: an n8n system that finds leads, builds a website draft, and prepares an outreach email as a draft for human approval.
- MapMyCode: an open-source fork that turns a codebase into a plain-language map for ordinary people, explaining what each file is, its role, and what happens if it is changed. https://github.com/ellsimohammed8-prog/MapMyCode
- NovaPilot AI: a meeting assistant for Windows that records and transcribes meetings and produces summaries. Meeting recording and transcription only.
- Cockpit IA: a sales automation concept demo, not a client product.
